title: Sync up define.PolicyMap and our internal parsing function
body:
#### What type of PR is this?

/kind bug

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

The internal CLI parsing function accepts aliases for a number of pull policy names, but we also export a map for API callers, and it didn't include all of the same values, and we use the map in `buildah pull` instead of the function.

#### How to verify it

Updated unit test!
New integration test!

#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:

Fixes #6992

#### Special notes for your reviewer:

#### Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?

```release-note
`buildah pull` now recognizes `--policy=newer` as equivalent to `--policy=ifnewer`.
```
